plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Port local par lequel Jeedom transmet se: The local port Jeedom uses to pass orders to the daemon. Change it only if that port is already taken on this machine.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Le portier envoie un signe de vie à cet: The door station sends a sign of life at this interval. Without it, a network loss would be indistinguishable from a day with no visitor: the plugin would stay silent believing it was listening.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Attente avant de retenter après une coup: Wait before retrying after a loss. The delay doubles on each consecutive failure, so as not to hammer a door station that is powered off.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.La photo est prise par le démon au momen: The picture is taken by the daemon at the very moment of the ring, before any scenario wakes up: that is the only way to catch the visitor still in front of the lens.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Nombre de photos gardées par portier. Au: How many pictures are kept per door station. Beyond that, the oldest are deleted.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Décoché, la commande « Ouvrir la porte »: Unticked, the "Open the door" command refuses to run, even when called from a scenario. The command is also created invisible: opening your front door should not be within reach of a stray click.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Identifiant inscrit dans le journal d'ac: The id written to the door station access log for unlocks coming from Jeedom. It lets you tell them apart from a card or a keypad code.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Combien de temps la commande « Sonnerie: How long the "Doorbell" command stays at 1. The door station announces the press, never its end: the plugin is what brings the command back to zero, otherwise it would stay there and no scenario would fire again.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Une ouverture par badge ou par code ne f: A card or keypad unlock does not ring the door station: without this picture, nothing in Jeedom says who just came in.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Le portier tient le journal de ses appel: The door station keeps a log of its calls. Re-reading it recovers rings that happened while Jeedom was not listening — an update, a restart, a network outage — and acts as a safety net if your model's event stream never carried the ring. The "Missed calls (24 h)" command depends on it: this re-reading is what keeps it up to date. 0 turns recovery off, and that counter then stays empty.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.À chaque sonnerie d'un portier où elle e: On every ring of a door station where it is ticked, the visitor's photos are sent to the service below, which tells whether it is a delivery person, a canvasser, a service professional or a plain visitor. These are photos of people: they leave your network. OpenAI does not use them to train its models but keeps them for up to thirty days; a compatible local model (Ollama, for instance) keeps them at home. Only rings are analysed, never badge or code entries.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Sans clé, aucune photo ne quitte Jeedom,: Without a key, no photo leaves Jeedom, even if analysis is ticked on a door station.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Toute API compatible OpenAI convient, ch: Any OpenAI-compatible API works, version path included: https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://192.168.1.20:11434/v1 for a local Ollama.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Il doit savoir lire des images. Le petit: It must be able to read images. OpenAI's small model answers in about two seconds, for a fraction of a cent per visit.
From 1 to 4, two seconds apart. Whoever rings often stands right against the door station, out of frame: their parcel or tablet shows as they step back. Each extra photo delays the answer by two seconds.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Sous ce seuil, le plugin ne tranche pas: Below this threshold, the plugin does not decide and classifies the visit as "undetermined": a "delivery" notification for a canvasser misleads more than a notification without a category.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Au-delà, la visite est classée « indéter: Beyond it, the visit is classified "undetermined" with the reason, and that category's actions run: you are told even when the service is down. From 5 to 60 seconds.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Une camionnette blanche est souvent garé: A white van is often parked across the road. We receive many Vinted parcels.
plugins/dahuavtobe/plugin_info/configura.Facultatif. Ce que le modèle ne peut pas: Optional. What the model cannot guess about your street.

plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Aucun portier pour le moment. Pour démar: No door station yet. To get started:
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Relevez l'adresse IP du portier et réser: Find the door station's IP address and reserve it in your router. If it changes, the plugin will find nothing and will not be able to say why.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Cliquez sur « Ajouter un portier », donn: Click "Add a door station", give it a name, then enter its address and the credentials of its web interface.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Utilisez « Tester la connexion » : le pl: Use "Test connection": the plugin shows the door station's model and firmware version. Commands are created on save, and the daemon starts listening for calls.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Le plugin parle directement au portier s: The plugin talks straight to the door station on your local network: no recorder, no cloud, no manufacturer account. This plugin is not affiliated with Dahua.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Adresse IP ou nom d'hôte du portier. Rés: IP address or host name of the door station. Reserve it in your router.
The account of the door station web interface.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Il est conservé tel quel dans la base de: It is kept as is in the Jeedom database: the door station only accepts Digest authentication, which needs the plain password on every request.
How the daemon listens for events. On automatic it tries one protocol then falls back to the other. Pin it only if you know which one works for you.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Les valeurs d'usine conviennent à la qua: The factory values suit almost every door station. The DHIP port of a door station is 5000, not 37777 as on a recorder.
1 unless the door station has several cameras.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Les événements tels que le portier les a: Events exactly as the door station sent them, before any interpretation. This is where you see what actually arrives when someone rings — codes vary between models and firmware versions. Leave this page open and ring: the list fills by itself.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.À chaque sonnerie, le démon prend quelqu: On every ring, the daemon takes a few photos of the visitor and has them analysed: delivery, canvasser, service professional, visitor. The "Visitor" command receives the answer two to ten seconds after the ring, and the category's actions below run. The service, its key and the confidence threshold are set in the plugin configuration.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Exactement comme une sonnerie, sur une s: Exactly like a ring, on a single photo: commands are updated and the category's actions run. It is meant to test a notification without ringing your own door. Save the actions you just changed first.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Choisissez pour quels visiteurs vous vou: Choose which visitors you want to be told about: a category without an action does nothing. Actions run in the background, without holding up ring reception. Tags usable in the options (title, message, attached file…): #portier#, #categorie#, #libelle#, #description#, #indices#, #confiance#, #image# (path of the best photo, to attach), #date#, #erreur#, #categorie_brute# (the model's answer before the threshold). As a precaution, a command of this door station or a lock-opening command is refused: an image analysis never opens a door.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Livraison ou courrier : transporteur, co: Delivery or mail: carrier, parcel, postman.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Démarchage à domicile : association, ven: Door-to-door canvassing: charity, salesperson, pollster, religious group.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Venu pour un service : technicien, relev: Here for a service: technician, meter reader, tradesman, official.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Une personne sans indice professionnel :: A person with no professional cue: family, friends, neighbours.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Quelqu'un a sonné, mais aucune photo ne: Someone rang, but no photo shows them: they stood out of frame, or already left.
plugins/dahuavtobe/desktop/php/dahuavtob.Le modèle hésite (confiance sous le seui: The model is unsure (confidence below the threshold), or the analysis failed — service unreachable, key refused, no photo. #erreur# says why.
